_doc: NWMP parameter-pack config for the Arkavathi (station-readings contract v1). Station codes come from the govCode prop Paani's monitoring-points compilation carries; only stations present in CPCB's RIVER tables match (the basin's lake/tank stations live in a different CPCB annexure and are left untouched). Run: python3 scripts/build_basin_wq_param_packs.py public/data/basins/arkavathi scripts/basin-sources/arkavathi-wq-params.json
